title: White Blood Cell Chases Bacteria
summary: A very short microscope clip of a neutrophil chasing a Staphylococcus aureus bacterium, originally from David Rogers at Vanderbilt University. It is a widely reposted piece of immune-system footage.
why: HN shares it as striking classic footage of the immune system at work, sometimes as an analogy for attack and pursuit.

quote.text: You can sense the frantic desperation of the bacterium as it tries to get away from something monstrous
